content: {"reasoning":"Authorization is on file and the claim has already been submitted, but no primary-payer adjudication is available to establish secondary or patient liability. There is no denial, information request, or identified claim error to support an appeal, records response, or corrected submission; another submission is not justified and risks duplicating an adjudicated claim. Because no available automated action can properly advance the claim, a specialist must verify its adjudication status.","action":"escalate"}
